rules: Validation labels are independent, uniform over states; measurements share the same invariant emission law
Private actions are drawn from logger conditional on hidden state
Reward is observed before the next signal; evaluated policies use only current signal
Retain all failed, singular and boundary fits in denominator
Compare joint information and independently centered two-sample sandwich; conditional-on-emission SE is an adverse comparison
Omitted-logger challenger evaluated on first 20 repetitions per calibration size; no global optimum claim
